title: Whereabouts Of G. Kum Alias Zung Bai Koong

page_data.en:
Form No. 2
G. 12000-1-19
3262
20/2/20
Shanghai Municipal Police.
CENTRAL POLICE Station.
19th February, 1920. 191
REPORT ON Whereabouts of G. Kun alias Zung Bai Koong( ).
Made by D. S. I. Givens Forwarded by Chief Detective Officer.
Sir,
Enquiries made go to show that G. Kun alias
Zung Bai Koong(鄭佩剛) is now in Canton, but his address
has not been ascertained. In the books seized last
year, No. 20 Cross Street, Singapore, was mentioned as the
address of an agent for the sale of the Bolshevist litera-
ture. Enquiries there may throw some light on Kun's
present address whereabouts for he was reported to be in the
Straits Settlements in May 1919.
Efforts to locate G. Kun alias Zung Bai Koong
are being continued.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D. S. I.
C. D. O.
19/2
File No. 3218 is a warrant for
G. Kun's arrest.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
中央巡捕房。
1920年2月19日。191
关于G. Kun（又名Zung Bai Koong）下落之报告。
由侦探副督察吉文斯（D. S. I. Givens）呈报，经首席侦探督察转呈。
敬启者：
经查证，G. Kun，又名Zung Bai Koong（鄭佩剛），现居广州，但其具体住址尚未查明。在去年查获的书籍中，提及新加坡克罗斯街20号（No. 20 Cross Street, Singapore）为一名布尔什维克文献销售代理人的地址。对此地进行查询或可有助于弄清Kun目前的住址及下落，因据报他于1919年5月曾在海峡殖民地（Straits Settlements）。
查找G. Kun（又名Zung Bai Koong）的工作仍在继续。
此致
敬礼
您的恭顺仆人，
侦探副督察
首席侦探督察
2月19日
档案编号3218系针对G. Kun的逮捕令。
